summary: More ansible.builtin.apt examples: cache_valid_time: 3600 to skip recent cache updates, dpkg_options force-confold,force-confdef, installing a .deb from a path or URL, state build-dep, autoclean, autoremove with purge, and clean.
questions: How do I install a .deb file with Ansible?
How do I avoid updating the apt cache every run?
How do I run apt autoremove with Ansible?
How do I pass dpkg options like force-confold?

answer_card.title: apt: cache, .deb and cleanup
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.apt:
    update_cache: yes
    cache_valid_time: 3600      # only if older than an hour
- ansible.builtin.apt:
    deb: /tmp/mypackage.deb     # or an https:// URL
- ansible.builtin.apt:
    upgrade: dist
    dpkg_options: 'force-confold,force-confdef'
- ansible.builtin.apt:
    autoremove: yes
    purge: true
```
